$comment: SSF Research Watch source registry. Sources are configuration, not hard-coded agent knowledge. Adapter keys name replaceable implementations; provider/model identity lives in config only. Every entry carries an explicit coverage_note: absence from the watch is never interpreted as absence from science. Network sources are disabled until a feed URL is approved for operations; enable them here or via their env feed URL.

sources.name: SSF deterministic fixtures
sources.coverage_note: Deterministic self-test data. Covers ONLY the works listed in config/research-watch/fixtures/works.json — a curated exercise set, not a science feed.

sources.name: Preprint and primary-literature feed
sources.coverage_note: Preprints and primary literature as provided by the configured JSON feed (e.g. an arXiv API bridge). Disabled until a feed URL is approved; covers only what the feed provider indexes.

sources.name: Authoritative agency and data-release feed
sources.coverage_note: Dataset/release announcements and authoritative agency outputs via the configured JSON feed. Disabled until a feed URL is approved; covers only the agency's own publications.
